summary: ansible-core 2.19 deprecated config and APIs: DEFAULT_UNDEFINED_VAR_BEHAVIOR and STRING_TYPE_FILTERS have no effect, DEFAULT_JINJA2_EXTENSIONS and DEFAULT_MANAGED_STR are deprecated (set ansible_managed like any variable), Display.get_deprecation_message is deprecated, and loading text that isn't valid in the expected encoding (usually UTF-8) is deprecated.
questions: How do I customize ansible_managed now?
Can I still enable Jinja2 extensions in Ansible?
Why does Ansible warn about file encoding?
